title: Preventive Effect of Caffeic Acid Phenethyl Ester, an Active Component of Propolis, against TNF-alpha-Induced Endothelial Dysfunction through the beta2-Adrenoceptor-Mediated eNOS/NO Signal Pathway.
authors: Lee, Seung Yeon; Bui, Anh Thi Ngoc; Park, Jin Song; Lee, Gi Ho; Maeng, Jeonghwan; Baek, Seung-Hwa; Yun, Hwi-Yeol; Han, Eun Hee; Lee, Seokwoo; Jeong, Hye Gwang
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜂胶活性成分CAPE通过β2肾上腺素受体信号通路改善内皮功能，属于小分子-受体互作与细胞信号转导，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE), a dietary phenolic compound derived from propolis, exhibits cardiovascular and anti-inflammatory effects; however, its mechanisms in endothelial cells remain unclear. In this study, we demonstrated that CAPE induces eNOS phosphorylation and NO production in TNF-alpha-stimulated endothelial cells. Mechanistically, CAPE-induced NO production is mediated by Akt, PKA, and ERK signaling pathways. In silico docking and pharmacological inhibition confirmed that CAPE directly engages the beta2-adrenergic receptor (beta2AR) to activate the Galphas/cAMP/Epac axis. Moreover, CAPE suppresses NF-kappaB activation and inflammatory cytokine expression through NO-dependent mechanisms. Ex vivo studies using aortic rings further validated that CAPE stimulates eNOS activation and NO production via beta2AR/Galphas signaling. Collectively, these findings indicate that CAPE enhances endothelial function and exerts anti-inflammatory effects through the beta2AR-mediated signaling, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic candidate for endothelial dysfunction and inflammation-related cardiovascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE），一种源自蜂胶的膳食酚类化合物，具有心血管保护和抗炎作用；然而，其在内皮细胞中的作用机制尚不清楚。在本研究中，我们证明CAPE在TNF-α刺激的内皮细胞中诱导eNOS磷酸化和NO产生。机制上，CAPE诱导的NO产生由Akt、PKA和ERK信号通路介导。计算机模拟对接和药理学抑制实验确认，CAPE直接结合β2-肾上腺素能受体（beta2AR）以激活Galphas/cAMP/Epac轴。此外，CAPE通过NO依赖性机制抑制NF-kappaB活化和炎症细胞因子表达。使用主动脉环的离体研究进一步验证，CAPE通过beta2AR/Galphas信号刺激eNOS活化和NO产生。综合来看，这些发现表明CAPE通过beta2AR介导的信号增强内皮功能并发挥抗炎作用，突显其作为内皮功能障碍和炎症相关心血管疾病治疗候选药物的潜力。
